endpoint: log10 native mole fraction; no conversion to mol/L
test_policy: No predictions or scoring before completed validation, decisions and review, plus exact frozen manifests. All registered methods retained irrespective of validation direction. No tuning after test.
strict_protocol: strictqa scaffold protocol732/93/144; original strict validation/test bytes preserved; source filtering based only on strict training
deterministic_methods: One run each; no mechanical seed repetitions. Base zero-shot identity/scaffold can share predictions only when exact public prompts, model, decoding and seed match; reuse must carry a provenance proof.

primary_contrast.support: Both effect thresholds; paired95%CI excluding0 in beneficial direction for both; all3seed directions beneficial. Otherwise unsupported or uncertain. Strict scaffold is a separately reported extrapolation check.

metrics: ranking best-solvent hit within0.1dex of block maximum
aggregation: Mean within condition, then within solute, then macro across solutes; report task-specific support counts. Average3learning seeds within solute before uncertainty estimation; report seed estimates and their sample SD separately.

bootstrap.interval: percentile95%; conditional on fixed checkpoints and measured cohort; not universal experimental noise or chemical-space uncertainty

tie_selection: Pair TIE selects a deterministic canonical-solvent order for regret; rank top1 tolerance0.1dex, raw regret remains unadjusted; no transitive tie clusters.
invalids: Included in denominator: pair accuracy0; rank top1=0 and tau=-1; regret=block maximum minus minimum. Report valid-output coverage; do not select only valid or supported questions.
candidate_scope: Measured same-source exact-T blocks, at most8 candidates; no claim of the global best solvent beyond supplied block.
budgets: max4train-only cards,1536evidence tokens,3072totaltokens; greedymax256newtokens; batch4 with recorded OOM-only4->2->1; no extra sampling or stronger tools.
consistency: 512label-free selected base questions and1024transforms in each protocol/partition; all core LM modes,14property models and10direct-evidence methods; raw and canonical-input controls for BM25 and Chemprop. Controls are preprocessing sensitivity checks, not new-method claims.
secondary_analysis: All nonprimary contrasts, ablations and fixed chemistry/solvent/temperature/nearest-train-similarity slices descriptive. Retain small/empty groups and all failed methods; no multiple-comparison confirmatory claims.
timing: Training cumulative across interruption segments; shared adapter cost counted once. Batch times deduplicated by batch_id across all saved segments. Last-resume invocation wall time is labeled separately, never presented as full-cohort wall time. CPU and GPU implementations/devices and loading exclusions reported explicitly.
correction_policy: Post-freeze genuine programming errors require a dated erratum, preserved old outputs, and rerunning every affected method under the same repaired procedure. Test results never justify prompt/threshold/hyperparameter selection.
known_limits: Missing pH, crystal form and some other conditions
Conservative source quarantine covers training-only archive matches, not all labels

Native logx endpoint differs from literature molar endpoints
Training record exposure differs between property models and bounded LM SFT and is reported
